properties.name: (2E,4Z,6E)-octa-2,4,6-triene
properties.description: s-cis,s-cis folded pre-reaction conformer used as the reactant node of the elementary step (C2...C7 = 3.35 A). B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, gas phase, Gaussian 16; optimization + frequency, 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest 51.3 cm^-1). Checked against the folded conformers of the searched ensemble: single-point energies of those conformers are 2.7 kcal/mol higher (-311.821465501 / -311.821465520 Eh), so RC is the lowest-energy minimum of the folded reactant manifold.

Concerted 6pi electrocyclization saddle of the allowed disrotatory channel; Opt=(TS,CalcFC,NoEigenTest) followed by Freq, exactly one imaginary frequency (-496.5891 cm^-1). C2...C7 = 2.27 A in the saddle. IRC started from this saddle runs downhill to the cis diastereomer (ts_0003/jobs/declaration_0004/irc/irc.log).

properties.name: cis-5,6-dimethylcyclohexa-1,3-diene (meso, 5R,6S)
properties.description: Both methyl groups on the same ring face (signed out-of-plane methyl distances from the ring least-squares plane are equal in sign, +1.5/+1.5 A). Minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies (lowest 116.7 cm^-1); IRC endpoint of TS1. Reaction energy relative to RC = -12.42 kcal/mol.

edges.description: Single concerted elementary step: bond C2=C3 and the C4=C5, C6=C7 formal double bonds are reorganized while the new sigma bonds C3-C4, C5-C6 and the ring-closing bond C2-C7 are formed. Atom map: [CH3:1]/[CH:2]=[CH:3]/[CH:4]=[CH:5]\[CH:6]=[CH:7]\[CH3:8]. dE(dagger) = E(TS1) - E(RC) = -311.793195944 - (-311.825755379) Eh = 0.032559435 Eh = 20.43 kcal/mol (electronic, no ZPE or thermal correction). IRC displaces the C2...C7 distance from 2.27 A down to 1.60 A with both methyls staying on the same ring face, i.e. disrotatory motion.
